decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already captures the LED change to 3.3V, direct ESP32 data drive, removal of the level shifter requirement, and deletion of the obsolete level-shifter part.
Moving the LEDs from the switched 5V rail to 3.3V does not change the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology or battery power path recorded by this Requirement.
The LED supply change does not alter the battery connector, pinout, placement, voltage range, or connection destination.
A same-message MODIFY already adds the SK6812 LEDs to the complete 3.3V rail powered in standalone USB mode.
The source changes a load supplied by the 3.3V rail but does not change the OR-ing method, participating power sources, or source-selection behavior.
The sensor-board connectors still require both 5V and 3.3V because the SPS30 and ZE08-CH2O remain 5V loads; no connector or pinout change is entailed.
A same-message MODIFY already adds the SK6812 LEDs to the monitored 3.3V downstream-current coverage, while monitoring both 3.3V and 5V remains valid.
The LED rail change does not alter overcharge, overdischarge, thermal, or other battery-protection behavior.
The battery NTC temperature-monitoring method is unaffected by the LED supply-voltage change.
The SK6812 chain remains the charge-status indicator; changing its electrical supply and data-level handling does not change the charge-status function or connector requirements.
The source does not change the configured DCDC1 output, I2C configuration, diode-drop compensation, or 3.3V downstream rail target.
The LED supply-voltage change has no necessary effect on the power board's eight-layer stack requirement.
